title: Cool to look at but sitting in?
text: Cool to look at but sitting in?. These chairs are down right scary to sit it. They are almost like a rocking chair in the way that they bend back. They are not stiff and when you lean back, they REALLY lean back with you. It feels like you will tip over if your not careful. I don’t think they are very safe and wouldn’t sit an older person in one.
